# device42_mac (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_mac" "myNewMac" {
   macaddress = "00:11:22:33:44:55"
   vlan_id    = "14"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `macaddress` (String) MAC address value (without separator or with colons). Used as the upsert key: re-applying the same address updates the existing record.

### Optional

- `port` (String) Port associated with the MAC address.
- `vlan_id` (String) Identifier of the VLAN this MAC address belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
